## Purpose

This activity practices a small set of pandas operations on the same General
Conference dataset used in Lab 3. At each checkpoint, predict the type, shape,
or contents of the result before running the code.

You will practice:

- inspecting a DataFrame
- distinguishing a Series from a DataFrame
- selecting labeled rows and columns
- building Boolean masks
- sorting by one or more columns
- translating a written request into pandas code.
